issue_request: FHIR-22670 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It reported that ElementDefinition.type.code is a uri with an extensible binding, but special elements such as Element.id used extension-only type metadata with no literal code/text value. The final decision was to use URI-based system type representation for the compiler-magic elements and, for R5, remove the dedicated terminologies.html#strings guidance while incorporating explicit extensible-binding rules for CodeableConcept, Coding, Quantity, uri/string, and code.
initial_application: FHIR-I minutes record the July 2019 approval and August 2019 revote after Grahame reviewed the technical-correction implications. Git commit a512331f23d8fd3278b3c54e4e494346d5cb90c3 applied the R5 source change by adding the bindable-datatype extensible-binding summary table to source/terminologies.html and commenting out the old Binding String Values section.
additional_context: The linked compiler-magic propagation problem is FHIR-22493, already represented on the combined branch by 1fe72a4d6e1f599c52275beee434233cce5a5743. Current source documents FHIRPath System.* URI type codes with structuredefinition-fhir-type where needed, and active source no longer uses the old structuredefinition-json-type extension-only pattern outside historical release caches. FHIR-13657 is also already represented on the combined branch and reconciles string/uri duplicate-code guidance without restoring the removed #strings section.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/terminologies.html already contains the required extensible-binding table and current type-code source uses URI values for system types rather than extension-only codes.
